verdict.rationale: Mastra is a developer framework, so AI insights over your data are something you build yourself. You write agents whose tools query databases (mastra-docs-29) and reason over the results (mastra-docs-15), and they can return structured output (mastra-docs-30). Inside the product itself, the nearest feature is model-graded scorers and live evaluations that automatically judge agent outputs (mastra-docs-49, mastra-docs-7), which you can inspect in Studio (mastra-docs-56). Missing for 10: any built-in, ready-made AI insights or suggestions feature over user data inside Studio or the platform; evidence that scorers produce actionable suggestions rather than metrics; independent hands-on corroboration.
